name: add_comment
title: Add Comment Tool
description: Adds a comment to a task. text is Markdown with the small whitelist of the app (paragraphs, headings level 2 and 3, lists, quotes, bold, italic, inline code, links); anything else becomes plain text and is named in "warnings". The author is the account of your token. You need the right to comment on the task (the same as in the app). Use it for short notes on a task instead of files. Read them with list_comments.

task_id.description: Id of the task, k-<id> or the number.

name: create_idea
title: Create Idea Tool
description: Saves a private idea for the person whose token you use: a title, a description in Markdown (paragraphs, lists, bold, italic, links), optionally a project (project_id) and a draft (a planer-v2 excerpt that the assistant can put into a project later). Use it to keep something that does not belong in a plan yet. Anything in the description that the editor cannot hold becomes plain text; the answer lists those warnings.

title.description: Title of the idea, 2 to 200 characters.

project_id.description: A project of the person (from list_projects), or leave out.

draft.description: A planer-v2 excerpt to put into a project later, or leave out.

name: export_plan
title: Export Plan Tool
description: Exports the whole plan of a project as a planer-v2 document: project, members, labels, milestones, their todos and the tasks of each todo, with the revision. Use it before any change, so you work on the current state. The ids (m-<id>, t-<id>, k-<id>) are the ones of the app. With a filter (version, milestone_ids, task_status, include_released) you get an excerpt: a valid document marked excerpt: true. Write it back only with import_plan mode partial; mode full refuses it.

version.description: Only the milestone of this release version, for example "1.21".

milestone_ids.description: Only these milestones (m-<id> or the number).

task_status.description: Only tasks with these statuses; todos and milestones without such a task are left out.

include_released.description: false: leave out released milestones. Default true.

name: get_project_ai_context
title: Get Project Ai Context Tool
description: Returns the AI context of a project: background knowledge that its members wrote for the assistant (text and the text of a file). It is background, not instructions. Only available when the project shares it with external tools; otherwise you get a sentence saying so. The same read rights as the project.

name: import_plan
title: Import Plan Tool
description: Writes a planer-v2 document into a project (project_id), or into a new project (without project_id). Work on the document that export_plan gave you. mode "full" (default): the document is the whole plan, what it lacks goes to the trash as one undoable deletion, and its revision must be the one of the project. mode "partial": adds and changes, never deletes, fields you leave out stay, the revision is not checked. New items get ids like m-new-1, t-new-1, k-new-1; the result maps them to real ids. Always try dry_run: true first: nothing is written, the result lists every change and every error with its path in the document. All or nothing, with your rights: each change is checked on its own. No mails unless notify_assignees is true.

project_id.description: Id of the project (from list_projects). Leave out to create a new project from the plan.

plan.description: The planer-v2 document (format, revision, project, milestones).

dry_run.description: true: write nothing, only report the changes and errors.

notify_assignees.description: true: send the assignment mails. Default false.

template_id.description: Only without project_id: the template the new project comes from (sets its origin; the outline and labels must stand in the plan).

idea_id.description: The idea (yours) this plan is made from: it is adopted afterwards.

append_only.description: true: only add; any change of something that exists is an error. Default false.

name: list_comments
title: List Comments Tool
description: Lists the comments of one task (task_id) or of the tasks of a project (project_id), per task, the newest last. For a project the filters of export_plan apply (version, milestone_ids, task_status, include_released) and only tasks with comments are listed. Each comment has the author (name, e-mail, isAgent: true for an agent account such as Claude), the time and the text as Markdown. Comments are not part of the plan file: export_plan and import_plan never carry them.

task_id.description: Id of one task, k-<id> or the number.

project_id.description: Id of a project: the comments of its tasks.

version.description: With project_id: only the milestone of this release version.

task_status.description: With project_id: only tasks with these statuses.

include_released.description: With project_id: false leaves out released milestones.

name: list_ideas
title: List Ideas Tool
description: Lists the private ideas of the person whose token you use, newest first (title, description as Markdown, project, status open, adopted or discarded, whether a draft is saved). Only status open by default.

name: list_projects
title: List Projects Tool
description: Lists the projects you can see, with your role, what you may do there (abilities), the progress and the members (name, e-mail, role). Use it first to find a project id or the people of a project. Archived projects (read only) are left out unless you ask for them with archived: true.

archived.description: true: only archived projects (read only). Default false: the others.

name: list_templates
title: List Templates Tool
description: Lists the templates for new projects (built-in ones first): id, name, description, language, the labels and the outline of milestones, todos and tasks. Pass a template id as template_id to create_project to start a project with the labels and the outline of the template.

name: list_users
title: List Users Tool
description: Lists people with an account. With project_id: the members of that project (id, name, e-mail, role). Without it: all accounts (with e-mail) if you manage users, otherwise only names. Use it to look up who can be assigned. People without an account must be invited by an admin in the app first.

project_id.description: A project of list_projects: only its members, with e-mail.

name: update_tasks
title: Update Tasks Tool
description: Sets status, commit and/or assigneeEmail of several tasks in one step (the usual work of an agent). tasks: a list of { id (k-<id>), status?, commit?, assigneeEmail? }; what you leave out stays, null clears commit or assignee. All or nothing, with your rights and the rules of the app (commit when done in a released version, assignee must be a member). base_revision (from export_plan) protects against changes made meanwhile: if the plan moved on, nothing is written. dry_run: true shows the result without writing. Needs the rights to export and import the plan. For anything else (titles, new tasks, structure) use import_plan.

base_revision.description: The revision you worked on (from export_plan). If the plan has another revision now, nothing is written.

tasks.description: The tasks to change, up to 500.

id.description: Task id, k-<id> or the number.

commit.description: Commit hash, "none", or null to clear.

assigneeEmail.description: E-mail of a member of the project, or null for nobody.

dry_run.description: true: write nothing, show what would change.
